section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants and procedure for a single study. A total of 353 college students (108 male; 245 female) with a mean age of 18.62 (SD = 0.97) were recruited. Participants completed a multisection questionnaire in a quiet classroom setting and were compensated with a gift worth NT50.
